impact: Broad AI and memory relief rally after a brutal November; positive for MU, DRAM, NBIS and PLTR into the open, but thin holiday volume and the short session mean moves can fade.
summary: US futures climbed after the Thanksgiving break, with Nasdaq 100 futures up roughly 2.4% to 2.9% and S&P 500 futures about 2% in early-morning snapshots. Micron was up more than 6% premarket, Nvidia more than 4% (above $155) and SanDisk nearly 10%. Europe's Stoxx 600 rose about 0.9% with ASML, ASM International and Infineon up 3.8% to 4.5%. US stocks close early at 1 p.m. ET.
title: Nasdaq futures up about 2.5%; Micron up 6%+ premarket into Black Friday
